app.name: tldx
app.one_liner: A Go-based CLI tool for bulk domain availability checking with combinatorial generation, real-time streaming, and AI agent integration via MCP.

screens.name: Domain Availability Checker
screens.purpose: Generate and validate domain name candidates based on user-defined patterns and filters.
primary_actions: Specify keywords, prefixes, suffixes, or regex patterns

rust_commands.name: completion
rust_commands.purpose: Generate autocompletion script for the specified shell.

rust_commands.name: mcp
rust_commands.purpose: Start an MCP (Model Context Protocol) server over stdio for AI agent integration.

rust_commands.name: show-tld-presets
rust_commands.purpose: Display available TLD presets for quick selection of curated TLD sets.

mvp_plan: week 1: Add support for --only-available and --limit flags
week 1: Implement core domain permutation engine (prefixes, suffixes, brace expansion)
week 1: Implement text and JSON-stream output formats
week 1: Integrate concurrent RDAP/DNS availability checker
acceptance_tests: Given 'tldx openai -p get,use -s ly,hub -t com,io,ai --only-available', it outputs only available domains like 'getopenaily.com' and exits with code 0 if any are found.
Input from stdin ('tldx -i -') correctly processes newline-separated keywords.
The 'tldx mcp' command starts an MCP server as introduced in v1.4.0.
When no domains are available under '--only-available', the tool exits with code 2.
